subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add a compaction-specific staged Gateway/WebChat diagnostics contract, and which compaction facts are safe to expose to users or operators?
rationale: The missing behavior is real by source inspection, but the fix adds public event/API or CLI surface, diagnostic retention/redaction policy, and overlaps an already-decided plugin path for Session Memory.

options.title: Narrow core observability contract
options.body: Extend existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata while keeping running-summary behavior in the context-engine plugin pattern.

options.title: Docs and existing notices only
options.body: Keep current start/end indicators, notifyUser notices, compaction hook messages, and diagnostics.stability, then improve documentation around existing knobs and plugin paths.

options.title: Dedicated diagnostics API
options.body: Add a new compaction-specific endpoint or CLI with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow core observability contract
recommendation.body: Extend existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, and failure metadata while keeping running-summary behavior in the context-engine plugin pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged WebChat compaction progress path and is the strongest current routing signal for the WebChat/Gateway event-shape decision.
